topic: Causal Hypothesis for Count Outperforming Weighted Average at m=10
problem_statement: Why does pure interaction count outperform Bayesian weighted average rating by 2.80x in HitRate@10 on MovieLens 25M?
solution_or_decision: Hypothesis: MovieLens 25M has extreme community popularity bias where blockbusters (70k-80k ratings) have widespread viewership across diverse user tastes. Weighted Average (m=10) ranks niche movies with high sample means (e.g., R=4.48, v=1,082) above blockbusters, but these appeal only to narrow audiences. This hypothesis requires further ablation in future tuning.
evidence: Observed top-5 list of Weighted (m=10) features niche movies with v ~ 1,000-1,600 rather than blockbusters with v ~ 70,000-80,000.
